readings: For each circuit country, average the constructors' stored season-to-date points (`constructorStandings.points`) and season-to-date wins (`constructorStandings.wins`), first within each race held there and then across those per-race figures, so each race counts equally (ignoring missing values). Return every country with its average points, its average wins, and its average wins minus the simple mean of all countries' average wins (each country counted once), without rounding.
queries:
WITH race_averages AS (
  SELECT
    c.country,
    r.raceId,
    AVG(cs.points) AS average_points,
    AVG(cs.wins) AS average_wins
  FROM circuits AS c
  LEFT JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT
    country,
    AVG(average_points) AS average_points,
    AVG(average_wins) AS average_wins
  FROM race_averages
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT
  country,
  average_points,
  average_wins,
  average_wins - (SELECT AVG(average_wins) FROM country_averages) AS wins_difference
FROM country_averages
